map.弱密码是账号被盗的首要原因。ToolBox 密码生成器在浏览器本地用强随机数生成: Weak passwords are the leading cause of account theft. The ToolBox Password Generator creates passwords locally in the browser with a strong random source, with no network access and no upload, and lets you set the length and whether to include uppercase, lowercase, digits and symbols.
